target_customer: AI application builders, robotics, voice assistant and batch inference users who need cheap, low-latency inference across GPUs and other accelerators
problem: Inference is expensive and tied to specific hardware and clouds; OpenRelay routes requests across a distributed network by cost, latency and availability.
business_model: Usage-based inference API on a distributed network of compute sites

founders.name: Jaden Wang
education: University of Washington (dropout, per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Source is the YC founder listing.

founders.name: Prashant Patel
prior_employers: AWS (founding member of Amazon Bedrock, led Custom Model Import)
founders.background_notes: Source is the YC founder listing.

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating inference across heterogeneous GPUs, TPUs and Trainium with a custom engine and routing is hard; both founders have GPU cluster and Bedrock backgrounds.

defensibility.rationale: Routing software is copyable by funded inference clouds; network of sites and customer integrations add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition reported as of November 2026; the market had many funded inference platforms.

market_need_then: Demand for cheaper inference was strong in 2026; the company reports over 5 trillion tokens a month and over 10M USD annualized revenue (company claims) within five months.

identity.logo: Not described by any source opened
identity.visual_style: Infrastructure brand framed as an Inference Delivery Network

branding.brand_signature: Inference Delivery Network (IDN) framing, a CDN analogy for GPUs

rebrands.why: Only a Dealroom note names the former brand; no official announcement or reason found.

branding.community_and_virality: A GitHub repository exists; trade press covered the August 2026 launch.

brand_strength.rationale: Launch coverage by RuntimeWire and Dealroom, but the name is confused with a different company, Relay, in news results.

outcome_analysis: OpenRelay raised a 10M USD seed announced November 12 2026, shortly after Summer 2026, and claims over 10M USD annualized revenue within five months (company claims). Experienced infrastructure founders and strong demand for cheaper inference support this, while funded inference clouds make the position contestable. Too early for an exit verdict.
notes: The 10M seed is recorded from the company's own announcement. A web search could not corroborate the lead investor, and an aggregator (FundedIQ) listed a 9M seed in September 2026 with YC as investor, unverified. Uncork's jobs board lists OpenRelay as a portfolio company. RuntimeWire coverage (August 29 2026) was behind a sign-in wall and did not mention funding. No competitor sources dated near the June 2026 founding were found, so the list is empty; OpenRouter and OpenInfer appeared undated. Traction figures are company claims.
